items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: I played with Don. Well, not played with him. He worked along with me in Detroit, Michigan.

ctx.x: No, we met Bob Cosby and what was his bad cats? I don't know if you ever would remember that, but we were doing fairly good and we had enough to eat. Bob Cosby didn't and we just stopped on the road and shared what we had. They were hitting it pretty hard.
Yeah, well you knew some of those guys probably by sight as kids. Right, right. Because a lot of those fellows were from New Orleans. Yeah, yeah. What about Don Redman? You never met him?
I played with Don. Well, not played with him. He worked along with me in Detroit, Michigan. That's where you had your big bands like Bikini Cotton Pickers, Fletcher, Harrison.
